title: One-Year Post-Closure Verification
abstract: Routine one-year verification that the Ash Creek siren remained inactive after removal of the shared conductor.
subject: One-Year Post-Closure Verification

body.text: Ash Creek Township provided maintenance logs covering the first full year after closure. No siren activation, unexplained cabinet voltage, or recurrence at the irrigation well was reported. The abandoned telephone pair remains physically separated and capped at both facilities.

The township removed the siren rotor in March 2020 and retained the cabinet as a historical fixture. The cabinet label accurately states that an undocumented energized conductor was removed in 2019. It does not imply that the siren operated without a power source.

body.label: Status confirmation
body.text: The case remains Closed — Explained. No monitoring extension, access restriction, or paranormal designation is warranted.
